description: {"time": 1783112257590, "blocks": [{"id": "1anqs6tn5x", "data": {"text": "Schizophrenic \u2014 one of Ongata Line Sacco's most talked-about designs \u2014 earned its name from a livery that refused to settle on one identity. Split compositions, juxtaposed portraits, and fragmented lettering created a visual experience that shifted as the matatu moved through traffic. Dennis Muraguri's 2019 woodcut captures that multiplicity with a composition that rewards repeated viewing. The design reflects matatu culture's maximalist aesthetic \u2014 more is more, and a single theme is never enough. Schizophrenic embraced contradiction, pairing a serene female portrait with aggressive typography, soft gradients with hard edges. The result was a matatu that looked different from every angle.
